proposals.title: Core nominal types and scale constants (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick)
proposals.why_now: Every downstream FASE-1 package — domain/ledger, world/price-generator, application/tick-loop, contracts/DTOs — is blocked at the type level until branded arithmetic types exist. ADR-003 is TRAVADO and specifies them precisely: Money/Quantity/Price/Rate as branded bigint newtypes, Tick as a branded safe-integer number. No DEFINIR decision affects these definitions. This is the shallowest dependency with the widest fan-out; nothing else in the critical path can start without it.

proposals.title: Write ADR-002 and implement deterministic positional RNG in packages/core
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 is TRAVADO: the hash function must be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any rand() call exists, and no native language hash is permitted. The hash function is listed as an open DEFINIR in §19. INV-02 — described by the spec as the most important test in the project — requires rand() to be stateless and positional: price(asset,t) computed directly must equal arriving at t tick-by-tick. All six world namespaces are blocked until rand() exists. This task can proceed in parallel with IDEA-001 since it does not require the branded types.

proposals.title: Write ADR-004 and implement bigint division helpers in packages/core
proposals.why_now: ADR-004 is TRAVADO: every operation that loses precision must declare a rounding mode explicitly, and calling division without a mode is mandated to be a compile-time or lint-blocking error. The enforcement mechanism is an open DEFINIR that must be resolved by ADR before domain code begins implementing fee calculation, notional computation, or rounding-residue posting (INV-07). Without these helpers in place first, the bare / operator proliferates in domain code before enforcement exists — a retroactive fix that would require touching every caller.

proposals.title: Multi-commodity double-entry ledger in packages/domain
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance requires 'Ledger multi-commodity de dupla entrada' and 'Ordem a mercado, compra e venda spot'. INV-04 through INV-07 are FASE-1 gates that cannot be satisfied without this. The ledger is the prerequisite for every domain operation — spot buy, sell, fee posting, rounding residue — and must exist before the tick loop and StateHash can be implemented. Once IDEA-001 (nominal types) and IDEA-003 (division helpers) are accepted, no DEFINIR decision blocks ledger implementation.

repository_assessment.current_state: Infrastructure and tooling are complete: monorepo skeleton, TypeScript strict mode, determinism lint (§13 rules enforced by ESLint), dependency boundary checker (§14.5), workspace configuration, and CanonicalEncoder with ADR-009 accepted and 101 tests passing. Every other package — world, domain, application, narrative, contracts, adapters, ui, all four desktop apps, and tools/replay and tools/bench — is an empty stub (export {}). No nominal types, no positional RNG, no division helpers, no ledger, no price generator, no tick loop, no save system, no CLI replay, no bench calibration, no Electron window, and no installer exist. The benchmark has been in this exact state across many consecutive cycles (checkpoints 0034 through 0041 all show NO_ACCEPTED_CHANGES with zero internal commits).
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: packages/core is missing the branded arithmetic types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick) specified in ADR-003 with no DEFINIR blocking them. Until these exist, world, domain, application, and contracts cannot be implemented at the type level. The positional RNG (ADR-002 DEFINIR: hash function must be written to an ADR) and division helpers (ADR-004 DEFINIR: enforcement mechanism must be decided) are the two other core primitives that must be resolved simultaneously to avoid compressing the critical path further.

warnings: The repository has been in the same state since before checkpoint-0034. Cycles 000093, 000098, 000114, 000115, and now 000117 all produce identical proposals because the codebase has genuinely not changed. The block is not in the Ideator role. If the same proposals continue to be generated without acceptance, the failure is in the Builder or Reviewer role and should be surfaced to the benchmark operator.

ADR-002 requires the hash function to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any rand() implementation exists. The choice is irreversible once any StateHash or reference replay value is recorded. Implementing rand() before writing the ADR violates ADR-002 and must be rejected at review.

ADR-004 requires that calling division without an explicit rounding mode be 'a compile error or blocking lint'. The enforcement mechanism is an open DEFINIR. Implementing the ledger before this is decided allows bare / to proliferate unchecked — retrofitting lint rules onto existing callers is a retroactive fix that has historically been skipped or incomplete.

FASE-1 requires a minimum installer for Windows and Linux (§14.6 TRAVADO: 'Não no fim'). The spec explicitly warns that deferring Electron packaging to later phases risks discovering ABI and native-module rebuild failures in the final week. No Electron setup has been started after 41 checkpoints. This risk compounds every cycle this is postponed.

The world price generator (§5.1) requires fixed-point or lookup-table implementations of transcendental functions (log, exp, sin, cos are all banned by §13 and ADR-003) producing bit-identical results across Windows and Linux under the same Electron/V8 version (INV-19). The approach must be decided by ADR before any price value is computed, because changing it retroactively invalidates all reference StateHash values and INV-02 test vectors.
